observations: Large A4 all-in-one printer wrapped in clear plastic film.
Brand 'KONICA MINOLTA' and model 'bizhub c3351' are printed on the front panel in photos 0, 1, and 2.
The printer is sitting on a wooden pallet in what appears to be a warehouse or storage area.
A blue sticker on the right side of the unit reads 'THE ONLINE TRAINING FOR YOUR bizhub DISCOVER HERE' with a QR code.
Multiple promotional stickers are attached to the front, including one for 'DUMEI ENGINEERING CLINIC LTD.' and another for 'OSLEE PUB'.
The top glass surface and the rear of the machine are not visible in any photo.

claims.evidence: The brand and model are clearly printed on the front of the machine in photos 0, 1, and 2.
The physical size and branding in photos 0, 1, and 2 are consistent with this description.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or may have internal mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and completing a self-test.

risks.risk: The internal components (drum and toner) may be empty or degraded.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner and drum status screen or a video of a printout showing the page count.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a full replacement of toner and drum

risks.risk: The paper feed mechanism may be jammed or misaligned.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine feeding and printing a test page.
risks.if_unproven: as having a paper feed issue

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner and drum status screen.
Photo of the rear of the machine to check for damage or missing parts.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
